system_prompt_style.evidence_quote:
The system prompt additionally informs the strategist of its three specialized briefers (Mili-
tary, Economy, Diplomacy)
system_prompt_style.note: Shared prompt structure (A.5.1) plus configuration-dependent sections; mechanism not shown. Quote spans a line break in the PDF text.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote:
the LLM strategist each turn receives a structured Markdown report
summarizing victory progress, available strategic options, player and city states, military
conditions
env_context_strategy.note: Closest value: a structured game-state report is injected each turn rather than a file tree. Briefed configuration summarizes via subagents.

context_compaction.evidence_quote:
The briefing pipeline runs before each strategist's turn to compress raw game state into
structured briefings.
context_compaction.note: Briefed configuration only; Simple (default?) sends the full report. Default between the two is not stated.

observation_format.evidence_quote:
The Simple strategist receives the full game-state report each turn as a structured Markdown
document

tool_call_format.evidence_quote:
interacts only through tool calls (no user interaction); may invoke multiple
tools per turn
tool_call_format.note: Call syntax not specified; tool calls assumed native.

tool_count.evidence_quote:
keep-status-quo(none) Maintain current strategic settings un-
changed
tool_count.note: Six shared tools (set-flavors, set-persona, set-relationship, set-research, set-policy, keep-status-quo); Briefed adds focus-briefer = 7.

edit_primitive.note: No file editing in this domain; paper-only, no tool registry available to confirm absence beyond the listed game tools.

protocol_standardization.note: Vox Deorum infrastructure not in evidence.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote:
The agent loop terminates after set-strategy/set-flavors or keep-status-quo is called,
or after 5 agentic steps, whichever comes first.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Call tools to set strategic parameters with written rationale for each decision

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
Simple, in which the agent receives the
standard game-state report
multi_agent_topology.note: Briefed configuration adds a pipeline of briefer subagents (orchestrator_workers/pipeline); default configuration not stated.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Simple configuration has no additional tools beyond the shared set.
delegation_mechanism.note: Briefed: focus-briefer tool steers fixed briefer subagents (closest subagent_spawn).

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: interacts only through tool calls (no user interaction)

short_term_state.evidence_quote:
Instruct a specific briefer to focus on
particular topics in next turn's report
(stored in working memory)
short_term_state.note: Also 'Strategies Current strategic settings and rationale from the previous turn' carried over.

long_term_memory.note: Paper says agents lack cross-game memory in this study, but no config surface available.

termination_condition.evidence_quote:
The agent loop terminates after set-strategy/set-flavors or keep-status-quo is called,
or after 5 agentic steps, whichever comes first.

cost_controls.note: Cheaper briefer model used for cost simulation; no harness cost control described.

execution_isolation.note: Game hosted on Jetstream2 instances; agent execution boundary not described.

replayability.note: Savegame replay mentioned only as future work (Sec. 6.3).
